integrity: The proof is self-contained, the verifier is included and uses exact arithmetic. Finite enumeration supplements rather than certifies the infinite family. No independent audit or external certificate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact distribution applies to upper-triangular \(3\times3\) matrices over finite fields of order \(q\ge4\) with \(\omega\notin\{0,1,-1\}\); it does not classify larger matrices, excluded twists, or arbitrary full matrix pairs. Unindexed equivalent special-case enumerations cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact twisted-centralizer dimensions for triangular \(3\times3\) matrices
